work.title: Giv Tid!
Give Time!
I Snee staaer Urt og Busk i Skjul!

incipText.p: I Snee staaer Urt og Busk i Skjul

physDesc.physMedium: 1 folio. Written in black ink. Paper: 16 staves. Tune only. Above the music: "Giv Tid! Køster No. 94." Verso blank.

2 folios with six songs from "Et Hundrede danske Sange" edited by Kristian Køster. Written in brown ink. Paper: 14 staves. In upper right-hand corner: "Køsters 100 danske / Sange / No. 94". Organ registration added in pencil in foreign hand.

physLoc.identifier: C II, 7 Hartmanns Samling 278 (Supplement. Kompositioner og Udkast)

physDesc.physMedium: 1 folio. Written in brown ink. Paper: 16 staves. Upper right-hand corner cut out. Verso blank.
1 bifolio with copies of all six songs from "Et Hundrede danske Sange". Written in brown ink. Paper: 12 staves. Above this song Hartmann has added in pencil: "Trykt" (Published).

physLoc.identifier: C II, 7 Hartmanns Samling 278 (Supplement. Kompositioner og Udkast)

physDesc.physMedium: Written in brown ink. Paper: 12 staves.

annot.p: The manuscript also contains: "Nu skal det aabenbares" (HartW 411), "Köster No. 18" without text ("Fremtidsmaalet") (HartW 409); "Sigrid og Odder Ebbesen (Köster No. 55) (HartW 412); "Dana i Dødsfare" (HartW 408); and "Fædreneland! Ved den bølgende Strand" (HartW 410).
